title: Elux Legend Pineapple Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Pineapple Ice offers the sweet and tropical taste of ripe Pineapple, perfectly balanced with a cool and refreshing Menthol finish. This e-liquid provides a delightful blend of fruity and icy notes, creating a vaping experience that's both invigorating and satisfying. The sweet Pineapple flavour is complemented by the brisk Menthol, making it an ideal choice for those who enjoy a fresh and fruity vape. Elux Legend Nic Salts e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strengths, making them perfect for adult ex-smokers or vapers seeking the swift and satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Each flavour is crafted using premium ingredients to ensure a clean and authentic taste with every puff. Nicotine salts in Elux Legend Nic Salts offer a smoother and more immediate form of nicotine relief compared to traditional freebase nicotine. Nic salts are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing quick and efficient nicotine relief without any harshness or throat irritation. Designed for use with pod systems and other low-wattage MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices, Elux Legend Nic Salts provide a more concentrated and flavourful vaping experience. They are the ideal choice for adult vapers seeking a high-quality, smooth, and satisfying nicotine experience coupled with great flavours. Try the Elux Legend Nic Salts line today and experience the next level of vaping satisfaction. Simple, reliable, and ready to use—perfect for refillable vape kits and UK starter pod kits alike.
